Accredited Hot Forging Unit

Closed Die Forging & Presses

Operating high-capacity belt drop hammers and friction screw presses in Pipadiya, Gondal to forge high-strength mechanical components.

Forging Technology

Closed Die Drop Hammers & Presses

Our closed-die forging shop is engineered for heavy stresses. By forcing heated billets inside customized tool steel die profiles, we realign the metal's grain structure to match the layout contours, maximizing fatigue resistance and impact toughness.

Tooling & Weight Parameters:

Friction Screw Press400 Tons capacity (Dharam)
Drop Hammer weight1.5 Tons capacity (Rattan)
Piece Weight Capacity0.500 kg to 15 kg / 20 kg range
Tooling Die Development100% In-house design on Haas VMCs
Metallurgical Performance

Optimal Grain Flow Orientation

Unlike machined bars or open-die cut pieces, our closed die hammers compress steel fibers so they follow the component shapes. This creates a continuous metallurgical structure, avoiding mechanical failures under heavy vibrations and shear stresses in heavy vehicle drivelines and agriculture gear transmissions.

Grain Size Audit ASTM Size 8 or finer
Yield Strength Enhanced fatigue limits
